why.en: This is exactly the ICMP echo request and reply exchange from the lesson.
why.hinglish: Yeh bilkul wahi ICMP echo request aur reply exchange hai jo lesson mein hai.

expect.en: Three reply lines with a time in ms and a TTL, then a summary with packets sent, received and loss. Some networks block ICMP, so a timeout is possible.
expect.hinglish: Teen reply lines time (ms) aur TTL ke saath, phir sent, received aur loss ka summary. Kuch networks ICMP block karte hain, isliye timeout ho sakta hai.

title.hinglish: traceroute se path ka map banao

why.en: Each hop is a router that sent back a Time Exceeded message.
why.hinglish: Har hop ek router hai jisne Time Exceeded message wapas bheja.

expect.en: A numbered list of routers with three timings each; hops that do not answer show *. The routers and hop count differ per network.
expect.hinglish: Routers ki numbered list, har ek ke teen timings ke saath; jo hops jawab nahi dete woh * dikhate hain. Routers aur hop count har network par alag hote hain.

title.en: Ping with a small TTL to trigger Time Exceeded
title.hinglish: Chhote TTL se ping karo aur Time Exceeded dekho

why.en: A TTL of 1 dies at your first router, which answers with ICMP type 11.
why.hinglish: TTL 1 tumhare pehle router par khatam ho jata hai, jo ICMP type 11 se jawab deta hai.

expect.en: A line like 'Reply from 192.168.1.1: TTL expired in transit' (Windows) or 'Time to live exceeded' (Linux/macOS), coming from your router. On older Linux ping use -t for TTL; the exact wording varies.
expect.hinglish: Tumhare router se 'Reply from 192.168.1.1: TTL expired in transit' (Windows) ya 'Time to live exceeded' (Linux/macOS) jaisi line. Exact wording alag ho sakti hai.

title.en: Filter ICMP types in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein ICMP types filter karo

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark to see echo, time exceeded and unreachable messages.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur echo, time exceeded aur unreachable messages dekho.

expect.en: Echo requests and replies in the ping scenario, Time Exceeded packets in traceroute, and Destination Unreachable packets in the last scenario.
expect.hinglish: Ping scenario mein echo requests aur replies, traceroute mein Time Exceeded packets, aur aakhri scenario mein Destination Unreachable packets.
